4624.name: Liquid Stone
4624.text: Bring a Healing Potion and a Lesser Invisibility Potion to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.

7981.name: Trampled Under Foot
7981.text: Bring four Green Iron Helms, four Green Iron Bracers, and two Green Iron Leggings to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.

7979.name: Barbaric Battlements
7979.text: Bring two Patterned Bronze Bracers, two Bronze Greatswords, and two Sharp Claws to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.

7982.name: Joys of Omosh
7982.text: Watch and learn the Omosh Dance of Joy.

7980.name: Horns of Frenzy
7980.text: Bring two Solid Iron Mauls, two Silvered Bronze Boots, and two Silvered Bronze Gauntlets to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.

12825.name: Corruption
12825.text: Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

3609.name: Supplying the Front
3609.text: Bring 6 Copper Axes and 6 Copper Chain Belts to Thorvald in the southern guard tower of Loch Modan.

12821.name: Snakestone of the Shadow Huntress
12821.text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.

12696.name: The Demon Forge
12696.text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained. You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate. Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

12824.name: Sweet Serenity
12824.text: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

12824.name: Sweet Serenity
12824.text: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

12727.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume I
12727.text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

12725.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume III
12725.text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

12726.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume II
12726.text: Return the book to its rightful owners.

12699.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets
12699.text: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

9367.name: The Origins of Smithing
9367.text: Bring six Golden Scale Bracers to Hank the Hammer in Stormwind.

7984.name: The Great Silver Deceiver
7984.text: Bring forty Mithril Bars and five Truesilver Bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.

7983.name: Smelt On, Smelt Off
7983.text: Bring forty Mithril Bars and forty Iron Bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.

7985.name: The Art of the Imbue
7985.text: Bring forty Mithril Bars and four Citrines to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.

277673.name: The Quarry's Smith
277673.text: Collect 12 Copper Bars and 4 Toughened Boar Hides and deliver them to Frast Dokner.

277673.name: This Is Spinal Axe
277673.text: Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.

18592.name: A Binding Contract
18592.text: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.

2889.name: Beer Basted Boar Ribs
2889.text: Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos wants 6 Crag Boar Ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt.

3734.name: The Rescue
3734.text: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.

3679.name: Thelsamar Blood Sausages
3679.text: Bring 3 pieces of Bear Meat, 3 Boar Intestines, and 3 Spider Ichor to Vidra Hearthstove in Thelsamar.

3681.name: Apprentice's Duties
3681.text: Collect 6 Giant Crocolisk Skins and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.

3678.name: Crocolisk Hunting
3678.text: Get 5 pieces of Crocolisk Meat and 6 Crocolisk Skins for Marek Ironheart at the Farstrider Lodge.

3682.name: Ormer's Revenge
3682.text: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill Sarltooth and return to him with one of his talons once the task is fulfilled.

5487.name: Dig Rat Stew
5487.text: Bring 8 Dig Rats to Grub east of the Crossroads.

21025.name: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops
21025.text: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan wants you to bring him 20 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 20 Deeprock Salt.

3735.name: Elixir of Pain
3735.text: Bring 10 vials of Mountain Lion Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

3680.name: Selling Fish
3680.text: Bring 10 Spotted Sunfish to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.

263513.name: Crab Season
263513.text: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.

2701.name: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs
2701.text: Gather 10 Lean Wolf Flanks and Stormwind Seasoning Herbs and return to Chef Grual in Darkshire.

263511.name: Restocking the Larders
263511.text: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.

3737.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
3737.text: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Chef Jessen in Southshore.

3737.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
3737.text: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

5486.name: Easy Strider Living
5486.text: Bring back 5 Strider Meat to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine.

3736.name: Costly Menace
3736.text: Darren Malvew of Southshore wants you to kill 8 Mountain Lions and 10 Hulking Mountain Lions.

18160.name: Klaven's Tower
18160.text: Steal the Defias Tower Key, break into the Defias Tower and uncover the contents of the Duskwood Chest. Take whatever information you find back to Mathias Shaw in Stormwind. Read Kearnen's Journal to gain insight about the tower.

18160.name: Mission: Possible But Not Probable
18160.text: Steal Silixiz's Tower Key from Foreman Silixiz, then kill two Mutated Venture Co. Drones, two Venture Co. Patrollers, and two Venture Co. Lookouts. Assassinate Grand Foreman Gallywix and take his head, then pick the lock on Gallywix's lockbox and steal the Cache of Zanzil's Altered Mixture. Take the Cache and Gallywix's Head back to Shenthul in Orgrimmar for further instruction.

728.name: Westfall Stew
728.text: Salma Saldean wants 3 Stringy Vulture Meat, 3 Goretusk Snouts, 3 Murloc Eyes, 3 Okra.

249489.name: Mysterious Mysticism
249489.text: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring 3 Greater Mystic Essences to Halea in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

277470.name: Harvesting the Harvesters
277470.text: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 8 Golem Isosprings, 4 Copper Modulators, and a Crude Scope.

6476.name: Deviate Eradication
6476.text: Ebru in the Wailing Caverns wants you to kill 7 Deviate Ravagers, 7 Deviate Vipers, 7 Deviate Shamblers and 7 Deviate Dreadfangs.

5083.name: Kodo Hide Bag
5083.text: Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.

277716.name: Beasts of Thunder Ridge
277716.text: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.

6710.name: Moonglow Vest
6710.text: Bring 1 Embossed Leather Gloves, 5 Embossed Leather Boots and 5 Embossed Leather Cloaks to Lotherias in Darnassus.

8406.name: Wild Leather Boots
8406.text: Bring 2 Nightscape Pants, 2 Nightscape Boots, and 2 Wildvines to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

8406.name: Wild Leather Boots
8406.text: Bring 2 Nightscape Pants, 2 Nightscape Boots, and 2 Wildvines to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

8408.name: Master of the Wild Leather
8408.text: Give Pratt's Letter to Telonis, the master leatherworker of Darnassus.

8408.name: Master of the Wild Leather
8408.text: Give Jangdor's Letter to Una, the master leatherworker of Thunder Bluff.

8405.name: Wild Leather Helmet
8405.text: Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

8405.name: Wild Leather Helmet
8405.text: Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

8407.name: Wild Leather Leggings
8407.text: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Helms, 2 Turtle Scale Bracers, and 2 Wildvines to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

8407.name: Wild Leather Leggings
8407.text: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Helms, 2 Turtle Scale Bracers, and 2 Wildvines to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

8403.name: Wild Leather Shoulders
8403.text: Bring 6 Thick Armor Kits and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

8403.name: Wild Leather Shoulders
8403.text: Bring 6 Thick Armor Kits and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

8404.name: Wild Leather Vest
8404.text: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Breastplates, 2 Turtle Scale Gloves, and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

8404.name: Wild Leather Vest
8404.text: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Breastplates, 2 Turtle Scale Gloves, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
